name: @spacefast/mcp

tools.name: execute
tools.description:
Use this tool only for a Spacefast API action that has no direct MCP tool.
Examples include teams, access, Links, rollback, domain changes, and claim continuation.
Make one execute call.
In that JavaScript program, search for each operation, describe it, call it, and verify writes with read-only calls.
Do not use an unbounded loop.
Do not use execute to publish content.
Do not use execute for deployments or build status. Use show_space_deployments.
Do not use execute for domains, DNS, or TLS. Use show_space_domains.
Do not use execute for traffic analytics. Use show_space_analytics.
Do not use execute to poll a publish. Use operation_status.
Do not use execute for documentation. Use search_docs.
Do not use execute to resume a paused execution. Use resume_execution.

Do not call skills before this tool.
Write one complete JavaScript program. Do not make a second execute call.
tools.search({ query, limit }) returns { items, hasMore, nextOffset }.
Select an item only when its path and description match the requested action.
If no item matches, use nextOffset. Stop after three search pages.
Use item.path. Do not use item.name or invent a path.
Call tools.describe.tool({ path: item.path }).
Build the smallest input allowed by inputTypeScript.
Common input groups are path, query, and body. Do not add unused groups.
Call tools[item.path](input).
If result.ok is false, return result.error.
If result.ok is true, read result.data. Do not read result.result.
After a write, run a read-only verification in the same program.
Return the final result. Do not return the search page or schema.

## Available integrations

Integrations you have connected. Their tools live under `tools.<integration>.…`.
- `spacefast`

code.description: Write one complete JavaScript program for one Spacefast task. Include catalog discovery, API calls, and read-only verification. Do not use an unbounded loop.

tools.name: skills
tools.description:
Read the optional guide for execute programs.
Call this tool only after you select execute and cannot build a valid program from its description.
Use the name "execute".
Omit the name only when the user asks which guides exist.
Do not call this tool for publish, status, domain, analytics, or documentation requests.

name.description: Use "execute". Omit the name only when the user asks which guides exist.

tools.name: resume_execution
tools.description:
Continue the exact program saved by a paused execute call.
Use only the executionId returned by that execute call.
Follow the approval or form instructions in the paused result.
Do not start a second execute program.
Do not use this tool for a pending publish. Use operation_status.

executionId.description: The exact executionId returned by the paused execute result.

action.description: Use the user's explicit response. Use accept only after approval. Use decline for refusal. Use cancel to stop the task.

content.description: Pass the JSON object requested by the paused form. Use "{}" when no fields are required. Do not invent values.

tools.name: publish
tools.description:
Publish files to Spacefast.
Use this tool for requests to publish, deploy, host, share, or put files online.
Do not use execute for these requests.
Publish the current workspace by omitting path and files.
Set path or files to publish another source. Do not set both.
By default, update the Space linked to this workspace. If no Space is linked, create one.
Set createNew only when the user requests a separate Space.
If result.status is publishing, call operation_status with result.job.poll.operationId.

spaceId.description: Set an existing Space id to update it. Otherwise, update the Space linked to this workspace. If no link exists, create a Space.

teamId.description: For a new Space, set the destination team id or slug. Omit it when Spacefast can select the only writable team. After team_required, retry with one returned team.

createNew.description: Default: false. Set true only when the user requests a separate Space. Do not also set spaceId. After success, this workspace links to the new Space.

slug.description: Optional slug for a new Space. Set it only if the user supplied a slug.

title.description: Optional title for a new Space. Set it only if the user supplied a title.

description.description: Optional changelog for this publish version. Set it only if the user supplied a changelog. This field does not change the Space description.

path.description: Path to one local directory, file, or archive. Omit path and files to publish the current workspace. Do not set this field with files.

files.description: Inline files to publish. Omit path and files to publish the current workspace. Do not set this field with path.

path.description: Relative path of this published file. Do not use an absolute path.

content.description: File data. Use plain text for utf8. Use base64 text for base64 encoding.

encoding.description: Encoding of content. Default: utf8. Use base64 for binary files.

tools.name: show_space_deployments
tools.description:
Read deployment history and build status for one Space.
Use this tool for the current deployment, older deployments, build status, or build failures.
Do not use this tool for domains, DNS, TLS, or analytics.
Do not use execute for this read.
Do not use this tool to poll a pending publish. Use operation_status for that publish.
Omit space only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

space.description: Space id, slug, hostname, or URL. Omit it only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

team.description: Set the team id or slug only when space is an ambiguous slug. Otherwise omit this field.

cursor.description: Copy pagination.nextCursor from the previous show_space_deployments result. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: show_space_domains
tools.description:
Read domains, DNS, and TLS status for one Space.
Use this tool for custom domains, DNS records, ownership verification, or TLS status.
Do not use this tool for deployments, builds, or analytics.
Do not use execute for this read.
Omit space only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

space.description: Space id, slug, hostname, or URL. Omit it only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

team.description: Set the team id or slug only when space is an ambiguous slug. Otherwise omit this field.

cursor.description: Copy pagination.nextCursor from the previous show_space_domains result. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: show_space_analytics
tools.description:
Read traffic analytics for one Space.
Use this tool for views, visitors, bandwidth, top paths, or traffic history.
Do not use this tool for deployments, builds, domains, DNS, or TLS.
Do not use execute for this read.
Omit space only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

space.description: Space id, slug, hostname, or URL. Omit it only to use the Space linked to this workspace.

team.description: Set the team id or slug only when space is an ambiguous slug. Otherwise omit this field.

tools.name: operation_status
tools.description:
Call this tool when publish returns status publishing.
Copy publish.result.job.poll.operationId into operationId.
If result.done is false, call this tool again after two seconds.
Stop when result.done is true.
Complete these status checks in the current user turn.
Report success only when result.status is succeeded.
Do not use show_space_deployments, show_space_domains, show_space_analytics, or resume_execution to poll this publish.
Do not use this tool for deployment or build status. Use show_space_deployments.

operationId.description: Required. Copy the exact value from publish.result.job.poll.operationId.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description:
Use this tool for questions about Spacefast behavior, setup, errors, or API use.
Do not use execute for documentation questions.
Do not use this tool before an action or for live Space status.
Set query to the user's question, an exact page slug, or an exact page path.
A query returns the best page in full and ranked alternatives.
Read the answer from result.page.body.
Use result.results only for alternative pages.
Call again with offset as result.nextOffset only when the first page does not answer the question.

query.description: The user's Spacefast question, an exact page slug, or an exact page path. Omit this field only to list pages.

limit.description: Maximum ranked pages to return. Default: 8. This does not limit page.body.

offset.description: Use only to continue a previous search. Copy the previous result.nextOffset. Otherwise omit this field.

kind.description: Optional documentation area. Omit this field to search all areas.

tier.description: Optional detail level. Essential searches basic pages. Full also searches detailed pages. Reference searches all pages. Default: reference.

instructions:
Follow an active continuation before you select a new tool.
1. If publish.result.status is "publishing", call operation_status with publish.result.job.poll.operationId.
Call operation_status again only while operation_status.result.done is false.
2. If execute requests approval or form input, follow its returned resumePrompt.
Reuse its executionId. Do not start another execute call.
With no active continuation, use the first matching request rule.
3. For publish, deploy, host, share, or content-update requests, call publish first.
4. For deployment or build status, call show_space_deployments.
5. For domains, DNS, or TLS status, call show_space_domains.
6. For traffic analytics, call show_space_analytics.
7. For a Spacefast documentation question or error-code explanation, call search_docs.
Do not call search_docs before an action tool.
8. For every other Spacefast API action, call execute once.
Put catalog search, selection, schema lookup, API calls, and read-only verification in that one JavaScript program.
Call skills only after you select execute and its description is insufficient.
Report permission errors. Never request broader permissions as automatic recovery.
Use a read-only call to verify each write. Authentication is not user approval.
